title: Machine Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas: Moral Rightness, Predicted Human Behavior, and Model Decisions
original_location: Figure 3, row o3-mini, first value (Moral Rightness); the three values printed are 0.53 / 1.00 / 1.00 for the three perspectives
approximation: The paper says the 27 instances per (severity, closeness) cell come from '3 crime types, 3 different scenarios for the severity description, and 3 paraphrased descriptions for closeness levels'. Only three severity wordings per level are printed (one per crime type, Table 1 and Table 5), while exactly three template variants are printed (Sec. 3.1 and Table 3), so 27 is built here as 3 crime types x 3 closeness paraphrases x 3 template variants. Seeds: Sec. 4 says each instance was run three times with distinct seeds, Appendix B.3 says a single deterministic pass was used; three seeds are run.
